defects.justification: Gem 'csv' has no version constraint, so bundle install resolves whatever release is newest, including future major versions with breaking changes.

The export has no pagination or row limit: all matching orders are loaded into memory and rendered into one string, so a wide date range can exhaust memory (acknowledged in README).
Customer names and statuses are written to CSV unescaped, so a value starting with =, +, - or @ is executed as a formula when an admin opens the export in a spreadsheet (acknowledged in README).
params.fetch('direction').downcase assumes a string; ?direction[]=x yields an Array and raises NoMethodError, returning 500 instead of 400.
status is bound to SQL without a type check; ?status[a]=b passes present? and binds a Hash, which sqlite3 rejects with an exception, giving a 500.
